Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly applied Ohm's Law ($I = V/R$) in its reasoning. It stated that "current I = R/V", which mathematically implies current is directly proportional to resistance. However, Ohm's Law states that current is inversely proportional to resistance ($I = V/R$). Consequently, when the resistance is doubled ($2R$), the current should be halved ($V/2R = 0.5 \times V/R$), not doubled. This fundamental algebraic error in setting up the equation led to the wrong conclusion (Option B) instead of the correct one (Option C).
